Class DinosaurGUI

java.lang.Object
DinosaurGUI
public class DinosaurGUI extends Object
Edgar Lopez CEN 3024C - Software Development 1 November 16, 2026 DinosaurGUI.java Provides the graphical user interface for the Dinosaur Data Management System. Allows users to add, display, update, remove, search, and import dinosaur records through a Java Swing application. Connects the user interface to the dinosaur manager, file reader, and SQLite database to support the overall objective of managing dinosaur information.
